summary: POMDOCTOR LIMITED filed a 6-K on November 6, 2026, disclosing receipt of a November 5, 2026 Nasdaq staff letter confirming regained compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement under Listing Rule 5450(a)(1). This resolves the October 6, 2026 delisting determination issued after the shares traded below $1.00 for 30 consecutive business days, and cancels the Nasdaq Hearings Panel session set for November 12, 2026. Class A ordinary shares continue trading on the Nasdaq Global Market under ticker POM; no advisor or board recommendation cited. Watch for renewed sub-$1 pressure and any reverse-split or capital-raising overhang.
